description: Indicative parking stall count for a change of use in Toronto, Mississauga or Brampton from the zoning by-law rates, with the by-law named. Confirm with the municipality. Indicative only. Parking requirements differ by municipality, zone and site-specific exceptions. Confirm with the municipality's zoning examiner.

brampton_core.description: Brampton only: the property is inside the Downtown, Central Area and Hurontario/Main Corridor area (Schedule B-7), which has no minimum.

city.description: Municipality (required). Only cities whose by-law we opened are offered.

gross_floor_area_m2.description: Gross floor area of the use (required). Each by-law defines its own gross floor area. Unit: m2.

use.description: Proposed use (required). Not every use is mapped for every city.

zone.description: Toronto: parking zone pza, pzb or other. Mississauga: parking precinct 1, 2, 3 or 4. Ignored for Brampton.

name: parking_stall_count_for_change_of_use
